name: inflector
description: Convert string case and inflect English words in DuckDB SQL. Rename struct fields, change camelCase to snake_case, or pluralize labels.

cta.title: Case & Inflection in SQL
cta.description: Install Inflector to convert between naming conventions (snake/camel/pascal/kebab/train/title), pluralize words, and rewrite struct keys or whole result sets in one shot.

quickStart.title: Convert names to snake_case
quickStart.description: Apply the same naming convention to two sample field names.
quickStart.sql:
WITH fields(name) AS (VALUES ('firstName'), ('PostalCode'))
SELECT name, inflector_to_snake_case(name) AS snake_case
FROM fields
ORDER BY name;
quickStart.note: Case conversion changes formatting; it does not establish that two names mean the same thing. English pluralization rules are a separate set of functions.
quickStart.requirements: Use a native DuckDB client. Inflector does not currently finish loading in this site’s Haybarn-Wasm 1.5.6 runtime.

introduction.title: Make names consistent across datasets
paragraphs: Inflector converts strings between conventions such as snake_case, camelCase, and PascalCase. It also provides English pluralization and singularization, plus helpers for rewriting struct keys and result-column names.

Use it when incoming data uses different naming conventions or when an export must match another system’s field names. These are mechanical transformations: they can standardize spelling conventions, but they do not decide whether two differently named fields mean the same thing.
